# Vendor documents (gitignored)

Proprietary protocol documents live here on each dev machine and never enter git history
(`docs/questions.md` Q6).

Expected files:

- **`genibelt-protocol.txt`**: the GENIBELT / Master Sort Control host interface specification,
  for writing the rules a portal telegram channel speaking that machine is configured with
  (`docs/questions.md` Q8: no suite code names it). Veredas 1 keeps a copy in its own
  `docs/vendor/`.

A machine without these files builds and tests fine.
